import re, importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_transform',path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def extract_grid(text, header):
    pos=text.index(header)+len(header)
    tail=text[pos:].lstrip('\n')
    lines=[]
    for line in tail.splitlines():
        if not re.fullmatch(r'\s*[0-9](?:\s+[0-9])*\s*', line):
            if lines: break
            continue
        lines.append([int(v) for v in line.split()])
        if len(lines)==20: break
    assert len(lines)==20 and all(len(r)==20 for r in lines), (header,len(lines))
    return lines
texts=[''.join(x.get('text','') for x in r['message']['content'] if isinstance(x,dict)) for r in rows if r.get('message',{}).get('role')=='user']
for idx,t in enumerate(texts):
    if 'Demo pair 1 input' in t:
        for n in (1,2):
            inp=extract_grid(t,f'Demo pair {n} input (20x20):')
            expected=extract_grid(t,f'Demo pair {n} output (20x20):')
            result=mod.transform(inp)
            print('demo',n,'match?', result==expected)
test=extract_grid(texts[0],'Test input (20x20):')
out=mod.transform(test)
